function.name: CalculateTax
function.description: Calculate the income tax based on the annual income, tax rate, and other deductions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

annual_income.description: The annual income of the person. This is a float type value.

tax_rate.description: The tax rate. This is a float type value.

other_deductions.description: Any other deductions. This is a float type value.

message.content:
先把 \(f(x)=x^{2}\) 的不定积分算出来：

\[
\int x^{2}\,dx=\frac{x^{3}}{3}+C .
\]

然后代入上、下限 \(x=3\) 与 \(x=1\)，得到定积分值：

\[
\begin{aligned}
\int_{1}^{3}x^{2}\,dx &= \left.\frac{x^{3}}{3}\right|_{1}^{3}\\[4pt]
&= \frac{3^{3}-1^{3}}{3}\\[4pt]
&= \frac{27-1}{3}\\[4pt]
&= \frac{26}{3}\\[4pt]
&\approx 8.6667 .
\end{aligned}
\]

所以，\(f(x)=x^{2}\) 在区间 \([1,\,3]\) 上的定积分为 \(\displaystyle \frac{26}{3}\)（约等于 8.67）。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "求f(x)=x^2在x=1到x=3的定積分。" That means "Compute the definite integral of f(x) = x^2 from x=1 to x=3." So we need to compute ∫_1^3 x^2 dx.

We can do it manually: ∫ x^2 dx = (1/3)x^3 + C. Evaluate from 1 to 3: (1/3)(27 - 1) = (1/3)*26 = 26/3 ≈ 8.6667.
